name: How do Denver area climate changes affect bathroom tile installations?

mainEntity.name: How do Denver area climate changes affect bathroom tile installations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homes across Denver, Centennial, and Parker experience significant indoor humidity shifts between dry winters and wet spring months, causing wooden subfloors to expand and contract. Rigid tile laid directly over shifting plywood will crack or pop loose without proper decoupling. Using modern uncoupling membranes or reinforced cement board allows the subfloor to move subtly with seasonal temperature swings while keeping the tile and grout surface completely stable and crack-free.
acceptedAnswer.description: Dry winters and seasonal humidity shifts cause subfloors to expand and contract, making proper uncoupling membranes essential to prevent cracked tiles and grout lines.
